name: @floor/assembly-lines
description: The walk kernel: pure edge-selection and back-edge accounting replayed over persisted visits, plus content-hashing for versioned definitions. Ported from lore's @re-cinq/lore-assembly-lines (transition.ts, definition-hash.ts) and adapted to the Floor's vocabulary: a node's outcomes are declared by its station rather than fixed to three, a node's human-ness is its station kind rather than a node type, and there is no failure classification, so every failure spends its edge's iteration budget.
